defaultPrompt: Help me design a reliable harness for an AI coding agent.
Audit this repository's harness controls and produce an evidence-based gap report.
Design reproducible evaluations for an agent workflow.
interface.longDescription: A skills-focused toolkit for designing coding-agent harnesses, auditing reliability controls, structuring safe automated loops, and evaluating agent behavior with reproducible evidence. Inspired by the harness engineering resource landscape in walkinglabs/awesome-harness-engineering.

name: harness-engineering
description: Practical workflows for designing, auditing, and evaluating reliable AI agent harnesses, with attention to state, verification, safety, and long-running coding tasks.
